title: DRY Metrics
description: Schema for the 'DRY' key inside the unified review-output metrics object.

value.description: DRY-1: count of EXACT/EXTENSIBLE codebase matches not reused. 0 = compliant, >=1 = SEVERE.
DRY-2: count of IDENTICAL/STRUCTURAL inlined duplications found elsewhere. 0 or 1 = compliant, >=2 = SEVERE.

additional-info.description: Optional: location of the duplicate and what it should be replaced with

value.description: DRY-3: count of generic patterns not extracted as reusable abstractions. 0 = compliant, >=1 = SEVERE.
